name: pool-maintenance
//: The budget of the onevcs pool maintenance onevcs.toml declares. Its measurement builds the workspace twice, so its host-labelled `budgets-host` target is excluded from every `check` tier: the release pull request's Linux check leg runs it after the gate (`just budgets-host`). `lint` checks the measurement script; `test` drives the declared command, and measure.sh's report and failure paths, against isolated one-crate Cargo builds without building the workspace.
